subject.title: fix(repair): read checkout v7 state credentials

question: Should a repository maintainer merge this member-authored repair once the remaining required checks complete?
rationale: Repository policy keeps MEMBER-authored pull requests open for explicit maintainer judgment even when the patch is otherwise narrow and appears correct.

options.title: Merge after checks
options.body: Merge the current focused repair if the remaining required checks pass and no maintainer review identifies an environment-specific regression.

options.title: Request runtime confirmation
options.body: Ask for a redacted immutable server-merge runtime transcript if maintainers want confirmation from the exact hosted checkout environment before merging.

recommendation.title: Merge after checks
recommendation.body: Merge the current focused repair if the remaining required checks pass and no maintainer review identifies an environment-specific regression.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository-member author of the proposed repair and can provide any requested follow-up evidence.
